options: Stages new untracked files too, then commits
Stages modified tracked files and commits them in one step (new untracked files are not included)
Commits only what was already staged
questions.explanation: `-a` stages modified tracked files; newly created, untracked files are not included.

questions.prompt: Which reset mode moves the branch back one commit but keeps the changes staged?
questions.explanation: `--soft` keeps the changes staged, `--mixed` (the default) unstages them, `--hard` discards them.

questions.prompt: Which one shows recent actions such as checkout, reset and branch movement?
questions.explanation: `git log` is for commit history; `git reflog` is for recent recovery history: checkouts, commits, merges, resets and branch movement.

questions.prompt: Which command undoes an older commit by creating a new commit?
questions.explanation: `git revert` creates a new commit that undoes an older one safely, without rewriting history.
